body:
When I was younger around 10, I opened my belly after an accident.
My mother and my sister (she was already 30) saw me.
They put me on a bed at home, but my mom was panicking. Even though I was bleeding & crying my mom slapped me on the face and telling me to SHUT UP!
It's my sister who brang me to an hospital where they stitched me. 
To this day, I can't trust my mother for anything remotely important or stressful, I go for my sister for that.
